reproducedControls: Exact byte pin verified independently through node:crypto test and Python hashlib receipt.
Unknown domain registry and raised limits reject PROGRAM_ENCODING stage8; matching schema/version labels are insufficient.
JSON reformatting and trailing whitespace reject because exact bytes are registered.
Missing/malformed/unknown bounds return a single closed Diagnostic from parse/check/elaborate; compile and simulator throw FrontendError with the closed diagnostic.
A full matching BoundProgram forged using an internal unregistered configuration rejects on derive registry recheck.
Backend registry/source/program admission precedes authentication and commit callbacks.
Missing local binding rejects PROGRAM_ENCODING8; absent actual backend retains PROOF_INVALID13.
Registry execution limits come from copied admitted registry, not a reread of caller-provided mutable bytes.
Detached buffers, proxy byte views, nonbyte views, and adversarial length getters reject without leaked host exceptions.
Exact8861-byte limit checked before oversized string UTF8 allocation and byte-view copy/hash; encoder/hash instrumentation verifies early rejection.
Earlier source-stage2through7 diagnostics retain priority over bounds mismatchstage8 where the public API reaches those stages.
Reduced-bound tests use an explicitly NONADMITTED internal helper; no public override was introduced.
remainingScope: This fixes registered-bounds admission and the tested malformed-input failures; it is not exhaustive frontend/evaluator correspondence evidence.
No proof backend, PCD, durable nonce/currentness implementation or native acceptance is established by these changes.
Internal parser/checker/validation modules remain implementation/test components; their products must pass the public compile/derive/backend admission boundary.
